 Today's forecast 
 Get the latest weather updates from the NBC6 meteorologists. 
 By Steve MacLaughlin • 
 Published 1 hour ago • 
 Updated 59 minutes ago 
 BOOKMARKER 
 NBC Universal, Inc. 
 NBC6’s Steve MacLaughlin has your forecast for today, Friday, Oct. 30, 2026.
 For the third weekend in a row, wet & windy weather will be the story, but Sunday is absolutely the wettest of the two. 
 Unfortunately, our sea levels are still elevated from the King Tides and now as we add a strong easterly wind and rain back to the forecast, we may still see flooding at times of high tide. 
 Watch NBC6 free wherever you are
   WATCH HERE 
 And then there will only be a few days before the next round builds in ahead of our November 9th new moon. Halloween is absolutely 'not' a washout. 
 It is windy with on & off storms at any time, but there may be a few hours in the afternoon and evening where the rain takes a break or at least becomes more scattered. So please keep an eye on radar if you have trick-or-treating plans. 
 We are hoping for at least a few hours where things settle down before really ramping up Saturday night, Sunday & Monday. 
 The next two high tides for Virginia Key are 1:16am and 2:04pm; for Key West are 1:42am and 3:48pm. 
 Boaters will have a Small Craft Advisory through Sunday.

 NBC6 First Alert Forecast – Oct. 30, 2026 – Morning 
 Beachgoers can expect dangerous rip currents Saturday & Sunday, with Broward beaches also under a High Surf Advisory for 10ft breakers. 
 Set your clocks back one hour before bed Saturday night. And know that there will not be any significant weather issues on Election Day; just a few scattered storms, but low impact.
 TONIGHT: Mostly cloudy. Numerous storms. Rain: 50%. Low: 76°.
 SATURDAY: Partly sunny. Windy. Storms likely with some breaks. Rain: 60%. High: 84°.
 SUNDAY: Showers & storms. Windy. Rain: 80%. High: 82°.
 MONDAY: Showers & storms. Breezy. Rain: 80%. High: 83°.
